name: Bun runtime
author: Oven
distributedVia: Compiled into every released binary by `bun build --compile`. Statically links JavaScriptCore (LGPL-2), tinycc (LGPL-2.1) and others — see the text for the full list and the relinking offer.
note: versionSource checks this against the RUNNING Bun, which is what `bun build --compile` embeds (the `packageManager` pin only says what should be installed). bun.txt reproduces this version's LICENSE.md and its statically linked library list, so when Bun is upgraded update this version AND re-copy bun.txt from the matching upstream tag.

name: zstd
selectionReason: BSD-3-Clause branch selected. zstd is offered under either; relying on BSD-3-Clause means no GPL obligation attaches to NarraFork.
author: Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates
distributedVia: Six raw CLI helpers in the independent same-repository helpers-v1.0.0 GitHub Release, built from SHA-256-pinned zstd 1.5.7 source; Linux uses a digest-pinned Alpine musl image, macOS native Xcode 26.0.1, and Windows the fixed llvm-mingw 20250613 recipe. Build-only output stays in .helper-release/, while the separately authorized legacy update-server tools route remains supported.

name: ripgrep
selectionReason: MIT branch selected; the upstream Windows ARM64 release supplies LICENSE-MIT verbatim.
author: Andrew Gallant
distributedVia: Six raw native Linux/macOS/Windows x64 and ARM64 CLI helpers mirrored from official fixed archives and extracted-binary SHA-256 values into the independent same-repository helpers-v1.0.0 GitHub Release. Linux ARM64 requires glibc, not Alpine/Termux. MIT and PCRE2 notices are attached to that release; the legacy update-server tools endpoint remains separately supported.

name: PCRE2 (ripgrep helpers)
author: Philip Hazel, Zoltan Herczeg and PCRE2 contributors
distributedVia: Included in the official ripgrep 15.1.0 CLI helpers (features:+pcre2).
note: Verbatim LICENCE.md from upstream tag pcre2-10.45, including the binary-library redistribution exemption.

name: LLVM compiler-rt
author: LLVM Project contributors
distributedVia: Compiler builtins statically linked into zstd-win64.exe and zstd-win-arm64.exe by the pinned llvm-mingw 20250613 cross-toolchain; its existing verbatim license text is attached to helpers-v1.0.0.
note: The verbatim LICENSE.TXT from the verified llvm-mingw archive includes LLVM's full license and exceptions; the compiler executable itself is build-only, not distributed.

name: MinGW-w64 runtime
author: MinGW-w64 project and runtime contributors
distributedVia: Statically linked into native zstd-win64.exe and zstd-win-arm64.exe, with the complete existing runtime notices attached to helpers-v1.0.0; Windows UCRT system DLLs are not redistributed.
note: Mixed runtime licenses: the complete upstream COPYING.MinGW-w64-runtime.txt notices are reproduced verbatim rather than reduced to a guessed SPDX identifier.

name: musl libc
author: Rich Felker, et al.
distributedVia: Statically linked into zstd-linux-x64 and zstd-linux-arm64 in helpers-v1.0.0, using the fixed Alpine image digest and exact musl package version with -static; its existing verbatim MIT notice is attached to that release.

name: GCC runtime and startup code (Linux zstd helpers)
author: Free Software Foundation, Inc. and GCC contributors
distributedVia: Conservative coverage of GCC runtime/startup code selected when the pinned GNU compiler statically links zstd-linux-x64 and zstd-linux-arm64; gcc-runtime.txt is required in the independent helpers-v1.0.0 Release. The compiler executable is build-only, not redistributed.
note: Verbatim COPYING3 followed by COPYING.RUNTIME from GCC releases/gcc-14.2.0 commit 04696df09633baf97cdbbdd6e9929b9d472161d3 in the official gcc-mirror/gcc mirror. libgcc/crtstuff.c explicitly grants the GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1. This runtime disclosure does not change zstd's separately selected BSD-3-Clause branch. Exact linked symbols remain subject to native build/link-map verification.

name: Go standard library
author: The Go Authors
distributedVia: Compiled into the six raw remote executor binaries published under independent executor-v<application-version> GitHub Releases, served to devices after protocol/version/source verification. Go standard-library and dependency license texts are attached to each executor release; legacy update-server tools distribution remains supported.

name: @parcel/watcher native binaries
author: Devon Govett
distributedVia: Eight platform `watcher.node` binaries embedded by scripts/download-parcel-watcher.ts, which fetches them straight from the npm registry — they never appear in node_modules, so the dependency scan cannot see them.

name: @cherrystudio/provider-registry (provider preset data)
author: Cherry Studio
distributedVia: Compatible provider names and API endpoints adapted from packages/provider-registry/data/providers.json into frontend/components/providers/provider-presets.ts and bundled in the frontend.
note: The fixed-commit subpackage package.json declares MIT and Cherry Studio authorship; the root is AGPL. No main src code is copied. The accompanying disclosure explains protocol/URL mapping and includes a standard MIT template copied from installed normalize-path/LICENSE, not a verbatim license file supplied by upstream.
